'''''Ophrys tenthredinifera''''', or the '''sawfly orchid,''' is a terrestrial species of [[orchid]] native to the [[Mediterranean]] region from [[Portugal]] and [[Morocco]] to [[Turkey]].<ref name="kew">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/synonomy.do?name_id=141835 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=ophrys+tenthredinifera Altervista Flora Italiana, Ofride fior di Vespa, Sawfly Orchid]</ref> The common name refers to a purported resemblance between the flower and the [[sawfly]], a wasp-like insect.

Many subspecies, varieties and forms have been proposed, but as of May 2014, none are recognized.<ref name="kew"/>
